Peak reminder for returning guests
Someone on the desk wanted you to know

Travel with pets: what to expect

Travelers should confirm their animal's booking details before arrival and keep paperwork easy to reach. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways helps guide each trip from booking through pickup, so small checks now can prevent a rough day later. Bring clear notes on feeding, comfort items, and any handling concerns so staff can prepare the right support.

Handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and every pet gets patient attention from trained staff. The desk also shares practical instructions with crews, which helps keep loading, transfer, and release orderly. If you are traveling with a pet, stay close to the desk, listen for updates, and keep your carrier secure and labeled.

If anything changes, tell the desk at once so we can adjust the plan and keep the trip steady. Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before departure and again on arrival.
